comments.text:
Create a high-level IntegraDevice trait/struct in integral-core that abstracts:
- Connection (MIDI port pair)
- Identity handshake (discover device ID)
- Part operations (read_part_mixer, set_part_level, etc.)
- Tone operations (read_tone_common, change_tone, etc.)
- Studio Set operations

This replaces the raw byte manipulation in CLI's dump_state() and similar functions.

AUDIT: 'I suspect we should have an Integra device interface that abstracts those operations'

title: refactor(cli): add high-level device interface abstracting raw SysEx operations
